VINODHINI M

Investment Banking Operations | Fund Administration | Fund Accounting Puducherry | +91- 9385311733 | kevinogilbert21@gmail.com

Professional Summary

Investment Banking Operations professional with 8+ years of experience across Fund Administration, Fund Accounting, Trade Processing, Trade Matching, Securities Settlements, Cash & Position Reconciliation, NAV Calculation, Corporate Actions, R2R Operations and Investment Banking Operations. Experienced supporting post-trade processes across Equities, Bonds, FX, Swaps, CFDs, MBS, ABS and Money Market instruments.

Core Competencies

Fund Administration • Fund Accounting • Trade Processing • Trade Matching • Securities Settlements • NAV Calculation • Cash & Position Reconciliation • Corporate Actions • Bloomberg • SmartStream TLM • SWIFT MT54x/299/599/103/202/210 • CTM • Client Reporting • R2R • Advanced Excel • SQL Professional Experience

BNY Mellon | Senior Process Associate – Fund Accounting (Sep 2017 – Jan 2024) • Performed daily NAV calculation and validation by reviewing trades, security pricing, Corporate Actions, cash & position reconciliations, and capital activities prior to NAV release.

Processed subscriptions, redemptions, capital injections/withdrawals, journal entries, management fees, custody fees, transaction fees, and credit interest for multiple investment funds.

Booked and validated investment transactions within the fund accounting platform,

ensuring accurate downstream processing and timely NAV delivery.

Processed Corporate Action events and validated security prices, coupon accruals, and

market data using Bloomberg Terminal.

Updated investment portfolios in Bloomberg to validate coupon payments, income

events, and Corporate Action activities.

Performed Cash & Position Reconciliation using SmartStream TLM, investigated

reconciliation breaks, and ensured timely resolution by coordinating with internal stakeholders.

Executed daily cash, stock, and asset reconciliations to maintain portfolio accuracy and

ensure completeness of fund accounting records.

Reviewed pricing exceptions, valuation discrepancies, and accounting breaks, working closely with Custody, Pricing, and Operations teams to resolve issues before NAV release.

Collaborated with Trade, Settlement, Fixed Income, Swap, Bank Loan, Corporate

Actions, Central Administration, and Client Service teams to resolve operational queries and support seamless daily fund operations.

Managed portfolio accounting activities covering Trade Processing, pricing validation,

reconciliations, capital activity, and income processing, ensuring adherence to operational controls and SLA timelines.

Supported month-end close activities by preparing journal entries, accruals,

reconciliations, variance analysis, prepayments, and audit support documentation.

Prepared client reports, MIS reports, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and trained new team members on fund accounting processes and operational best practices.

BNP Paribas Securities Services | Associate (Mar 2015 – Sep 2017) • Managed end-to-end trade matching, trade processing, and securities settlement activities across Equities, Bonds, MBS, ABS, Foreign Exchange, and Money Market instruments.

Performed CTM, SWIFT, and manual trade confirmations, ensuring timely trade

affirmation within market cut-off timelines.

Prepared SWIFT MT54x, MT299, MT599, MT103, MT202, and MT210 settlement

instructions, including SSI amendments, funding instructions, and partial settlements.

Ensured timely FX and securities matching, maintaining compliance with SLA,

operational controls, and market deadlines.

Executed cash and stock reconciliations, investigated reconciliation breaks, and resolved settlement exceptions through coordination with brokers, custodians, counterparties, and clients.

Managed settlement fails, followed escalation procedures, and ensured timely

resolution of operational issues.

Supported UAT, process improvements, operational reporting, and created process

documentation to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention.

Coordinated with internal stakeholders and technology teams to support system enhancements while ensuring error-free deliverables and audit compliance.

Achievements • Received Spot Award for Better Client Services and successfully managing high

transaction volumes across multiple operational processes. • Recognized as part of the Team of the Quarter Award (2016). • Achieved 100% process accuracy, receiving appreciation and recognition from clients

and senior management.

Trained new team members by providing end-to-end process knowledge and preparing

standard operating procedures.

Education & Certifications

Certified Investment Banking Operations Professional

Imarticus Learning | Chennai | 2015

Master of Business Administration (International Business) Pondicherry University | 2012 – 2014 | CGPA: 7.05 • Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com) Bharathidasan Government College | 70% • Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) | 83.85% • Secondary School Leaving Certificate (SSLC) |85% TECHNICAL SKILLS

Bloomberg Terminal • SmartStream TLM • Advanced Excel • SQL • Microsoft Office PROJECTS

ATC Chemicals – Puducherry Interpersonal Relationship and its Impact on Employee Creativity • Reliance Communication – Chennai Study on Time Management INTERNSHIP

xlabs – Puducherry Import & Export Documentation Procedures

PROFESSIONAL SKILLS

Financial Reporting • Performance Management • Change Management • Talent Management

Advanced Excel • SQL • MS Office

EXTRA-CURRICULAR ACTIVITIES

Participated in Adzap during AURA'13 – PIMS, Puducherry • Participated in Poster Presentation Competition during GLOBIZZ 2013 – Pondicherry University

Organized departmental event GLOBIZZ 2013

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
Professional Experience
BNY Mellon | Senior Process Associate – Fund Accounting (Sep 2017 – Jan 2024) • Performed daily NAV calculation and validation by reviewing trades, security pricing, Corporate Actions, cash & position reconciliations, and capital activities prior to NAV release.
Processed subscriptions, redemptions, capital injections/withdrawals, journal entries, management fees, custody fees, transaction fees, and credit interest for multiple investment funds.
Booked and validated investment transactions within the fund accounting platform,
ensuring accurate downstream processing and timely NAV delivery.
Processed Corporate Action events and validated security prices, coupon accruals, and
market data using Bloomberg Terminal.
Updated investment portfolios in Bloomberg to validate coupon payments, income
events, and Corporate Action activities.
Performed Cash & Position Reconciliation using SmartStream TLM, investigated
reconciliation breaks, and ensured timely resolution by coordinating with internal stakeholders.
Executed daily cash, stock, and asset reconciliations to maintain portfolio accuracy and
ensure completeness of fund accounting records.
Reviewed pricing exceptions, valuation discrepancies, and accounting breaks, working closely with Custody, Pricing, and Operations teams to resolve issues before NAV release.
Collaborated with Trade, Settlement, Fixed Income, Swap, Bank Loan, Corporate
Actions, Central Administration, and Client Service teams to resolve operational queries and support seamless daily fund operations.
Managed portfolio accounting activities covering Trade Processing, pricing validation,
reconciliations, capital activity, and income processing, ensuring adherence to operational controls and SLA timelines.
Supported month-end close activities by preparing journal entries, accruals,
reconciliations, variance analysis, prepayments, and audit support documentation.
Prepared client reports, MIS reports, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and trained new team members on fund accounting processes and operational best practices.
BNP Paribas Securities Services | Associate (Mar 2015 – Sep 2017) • Managed end-to-end trade matching, trade processing, and securities settlement activities across Equities, Bonds, MBS, ABS, Foreign Exchange, and Money Market instruments.
Performed CTM, SWIFT, and manual trade confirmations, ensuring timely trade
affirmation within market cut-off timelines.
Prepared SWIFT MT54x, MT299, MT599, MT103, MT202, and MT210 settlement
instructions, including SSI amendments, funding instructions, and partial settlements.
Ensured timely FX and securities matching, maintaining compliance with SLA,
operational controls, and market deadlines.
Executed cash and stock reconciliations, investigated reconciliation breaks, and resolved settlement exceptions through coordination with brokers, custodians, counterparties, and clients.
Managed settlement fails, followed escalation procedures, and ensured timely
resolution of operational issues.
Supported UAT, process improvements, operational reporting, and created process
documentation to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention.
Coordinated with internal stakeholders and technology teams to support system enhancements while ensuring error-free deliverables and audit compliance.
Pondicherry University | 2012 – 2014 | CGPA: 7.05 • Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com) Bharathidasan Government College | 70% • Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) | 83.85% • Secondary School Leaving Certificate (SSLC) |85%
